query: SELECT strftime(date_trunc('month', date), '%Y-%m') AS month, count(DISTINCT tx_hash) AS txs FROM (SELECT date, tx_hash FROM (SELECT date, tx_hash, script_hash AS h FROM transaction_scripts WHERE date in <year window> UNION ALL SELECT date, tx_hash, owner_payment_credential AS h FROM address_utxo WHERE date >= DATE '2021-09-01' AND date < DATE '2022-01-01') WHERE h IN ('27d46ecbec94b052d8f875cf3beafd0e8ca40e8ad069f677e0a128ea', 'a76f0fb801a29f591e9871576508d85b0b5f3c38774f65032f58fdad')) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
